lines.en: Water slips through my fingers.
I drag my legs across the shallows.
The shore is dry; I move slowly.
Do not rush me; my fins are useless here.
Each step leaves a wet trail.
Wet clay clings to my feet.
I am looking for a slope back to water.
The smell of the riverbed pulls me on.
Algae threads hang from my ankles.
Three steps forward, one slide back.
My skin tightens in the wind.
I have swum past this bank many times.
I listen to the sounds underwater.
My gills flutter slowly on land.
Waterweed tangles in my hair.
I remember my last breath of air.
Stay too long and my skin cracks.
Something moves in the river.
I count footsteps on the bank.
This body does not mind cold water.
Row after row, my teeth itch.
The algae taste bitter under my tongue.
My reflection twists into a line.
I wait for the tide to rise a little.
Many bones are buried in the mud.
Do not cast your net over my head.
Mycelium hangs from my gills.

lines.zh: 我没死，只是一直在水下。
lines.en: I did not die; I simply stayed under.
The river mud is softer than the bank.

lines.zh: 我记得自己的名字，不常说。
lines.en: I remember my name. I rarely say it.
You have stood on the bank too long.
Come down; the water is cool.
I know footprints like yours.
Your reflection moves before you do.
Do not step back; the river is behind you.
You smell of dry earth.
We have watched each other three seconds.
Your hand is reaching for a weapon.
Do not take your eyes off the water.
I have counted your blinks.
You smile like a man casting a net.
One step forward and the water reaches your waist.

lines.zh: 伤口里淌出的都是河水。
lines.en: River water runs out of my wound.
My scales have split open.
Away from water too long, I weaken.
The blow left my gills stuck open.
Mud got into my gills.
You snapped my fin.
I will swim off rather than fight.
The wound stings the moment it meets water.
My blood clouds the water.
Follow me into water and you lose.
Is that a fish in your hand?
That fish is still flopping.
Give it here and I will stop chasing.
Raw fish has the clearest smell.
I do not eat anything cooked.
You carry a creel, do you not?
Do not hide the fish behind your back.
Just one. I only want one.
Underwater I am faster than you.
Fish blood is dripping into the river.
You stepped into my pool.
Do not touch me; my feet slide.
Wet hands cannot grip anything.
You scattered my algae.
Move; I am going back to the water.
On land I cannot beat you.
Your boot crushed my fin.
Not so close; I will slip.
One move of mine soaks your side.
We both slip in the same mud.
The nest underwater is finished.
Your scales match mine.
Let us guard this shallow together.
I saved the fattest fish for you.
Do not swim far; the water muddies.
Our eggs hide in the rock crevice.
The water stills when you sing.
Two naiads, one river.
I know the sound of your swimming.
The bank is cold; come closer.
Something is under this stone.
I found a wet, bright scale.
It does not matter that it sank.
This shell can be ground into a blade.
I carry it in my teeth to the nest.
Let go; that bottle is mine.
Bones are wrapped in the waterweed.
Everything I pick up drips.
This scrap of iron is still sharp.
I hide it in a hole in the riverbed.
You are far from water. Perfect.
There is blood in the water. I taste it.
Do not run to deep water; that is mine.
You are already in my river.
Today I drag you under.
You splash too loudly.
My gills are flaring open.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤口，我闻得到。
lines.en: You are wounded; I can smell it.
You are alone on this bank.
This river has waited days for you.
I am judging the depth.
The stone is at your back. Nowhere left.
One more step and your boots are wet.
I approach just under the surface.
Do not look behind you; there is no path.
My fingers are already spread.
Your breathing has gone ragged.
The current hides my steps.
I wait for one slip of your foot.
The distance is right. One arm's reach.
Once I grip an ankle, I do not let go.
My nails drag downward.
Wet hands tear through easily.
You should have stayed on the bank.
This bite comes with river water.
I pull you toward the deep.
Your armor is heavy in water.
Do not struggle; it only deepens.
My teeth are fine, and many.
Threads of blood spread through the river.

lines.zh: 淤泥里翻上来一个人影。
lines.en: A shape rises out of the silt.
This water is new to me.
A drowned one opens his eyes again.
Mycelium grows even in water.
The wind on the bank stings.
First, find deep water to hide in.
I remember the feeling of sinking.
This river smells too clean.
Someone walks on the bridge.
River water still drips from my scales.
Let me follow the current a while.
Stay from the water; I just woke.
Fire curls my scales.
I hit the stone; my bones clicked.

lines.zh: 我早该淹死了，可还是怕。
lines.en: I already drowned once, yet I still fear it.
The blast throws the water apart and me with it.
An arrow came from the bank into the water.

lines.zh: 这咒让我想起溺死那刻。
lines.en: This spell brings back my drowning.
There are no fish left in the river.
Lightning strikes the water; I go numb.
There is not even water here.
